casaDeMunecas.descripcion: Lead. Travels the whole play from domestic comfort to the final break. Calls for command of silence as much as of the text.
casaDeMunecas.sinopsis: Henrik Ibsen, 1879. Nora keeps up a seemingly happy marriage built on a secret she signed herself. When it comes out, she discovers how much of her life was a part written by others.

bodasDeSangre.descripcion: Central role. She marries one man while still bound to another. Needs a body ready to work: the play calls for physical work and chorus.
bodasDeSangre.sinopsis: Federico García Lorca, 1933. A wedding in the Andalusian countryside falls apart when the bride runs off with Leonardo, the only character in the play with a name of his own. A tragedy in verse and prose.

romeoYJulieta.descripcion: Small-venue staging, with few fixtures and many shifts in mood. Looking for someone who has lit text-based theater.
romeoYJulieta.sinopsis: William Shakespeare, c. 1595. Two young people from feuding families fall in love and rush a plan that ends badly. The most retold story of impossible love.
